comparison.objective: Replace a food shield over a salad bar with its front lip 18–30 cm beyond the food.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object grasping, orientation and placement to a measured overhang, not narrow-tool alignment, hammering or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Shield restored with 18–30 cm front-lip overhang; other stability, collision and contamination criteria are missing. Candidate requires four valid fractures and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: It tests measured placement of a protective barrier rather than precision impact fracture.
